name: Evermore
description: Romantic, film-toned wedding and elopement photographer site with polaroid prints that drop onto the page and an accessible keyboard lightbox.
features: Illustrated sunset hero with film grain and a drifting light leak
Polaroid gallery whose prints drop and settle at a tilt as you scroll
Lightbox with arrow-key browsing, Esc to close and a focus trap
Arched collection cards, testimonials, FAQ and date enquiry form
signature: Polaroid prints drop onto the page and settle with a gentle tilt; tap one to open an accessible lightbox
